description: Place a SANDBOX order: nothing ships and no money moves. payment.method is 'card', 'usdc' or 'usdt'. card: only test cards work (4242424242424242 succeeds, 4000000000000002 declines; any future expiry, any 3-digit cvc). usdc (networks base, ethereum, solana, polygon) or usdt (ethereum, tron, solana): returns a simulated payment_request with the amount in token units (6 decimals), a SANDBOX pay_to that is not a real address, and an expiry; then call confirm_crypto_payment with a fake tx hash. Never send real funds or a real card.
name: checkout
title: Check out (sandbox: test card, USDC or USDT)
